title: Fanzy Zones - Difficulty adjusting zones
author: ybacoder
summary: The FancyZones report describes the uppermost zone gets selected, which makes it difficult to edit buried zones.

proposed_fixes.title: Use closest-center hit testing for overlapping zones in the layout editor
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The layout editor selects the topmost overlapping zone rather than applying the closest-center rule already available for runtime snapping.
plan: Locate zone hit testing in the FancyZones layout editor.
When multiple zones contain the pointer, select the zone whose center is closest to the pointer, matching the runtime overlap option.
Add editor interaction tests for overlapping zones and stable selection at equal distances.
verification: Create overlapping zones, click points inside more than one zone, and confirm the closest-center zone is selected consistently.
